_note: DRAFT content for variant Sections 5 (Buying Checklist) & 6 (Technical Specs) - review before launch. Keyed by engine family (same keys as engineGuide.json). 'checks' override the default checklist card text for that engine; torque is a range where outputs differ by variant.

defaultChecks.coldStart: Listen for a smooth start; any hesitation, rattle or excessive smoke points to fuel or timing issues
defaultChecks.service: Look for regular oil changes and evidence of the key maintenance items being done on time
defaultChecks.coolant: Check for pressurised hoses, oil in the coolant, or unexplained coolant loss (head gasket warning)
defaultChecks.turbo: Test acceleration; any lack of power, whistling or excessive smoke needs investigating
defaultChecks.oil: Check around the rear of the engine, the sump and the timing cover for leaks
defaultChecks.smoke: Blue smoke = oil burning; black smoke = over-fuelling; white smoke = coolant ingress
defaultChecks.warning: Any engine warning light should be diagnosed with a proper scan before you buy
defaultChecks.mot: Check MOT history online for emissions failures, advisories and recurring faults
